'''Issagra space station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located in the [[Issagra system/Legends|Issagra system]] of the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]], in orbit of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Issagra]].

Issagra could hold more than 10,000 visitors, could hold more than 100 freighters of cargo, and was over 3 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] in length. The station served as a center of trade and was notable for its [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]]. It was a haven for criminals. Organized crime groups were always in hiding in the background of Issagra Station, and contraband was not uncommon.

The wealthy [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] gambler [[Garoush]] was present in a casino on Issagra space station when he ran into a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] on the run from another group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]].
